newsitem.title: GERMANY: ADtranz and GE unveil new locomotive.
newsitem.headline: ADtranz and GE unveil new locomotive.

text.p: ADtranz and General Electric Transportation systems unveiled on Tuesday a new diesel-electric locomotive that will compete in a market estimated at more than $1 billion by the end of the century.
ADtranz, the joint venture of ABB Ltd and Daimler-Benz AG, and GE spent 12 months developing the locomotive, dubbed the "Blue Tiger", and is considered a light-weight model at 108 tonnes.
The locomotive has a top speed of 200 kilometers per hour.

"This quantum leap in technology gives us an edge that cannot be underestimated, because it was possible to limit axle loads to under 25 tonnes for all planned configurations of the locomotive while maintaining the structural strength of the unit," said ADtranz chief executive officer Kaare Vagner.
ADtranz is responsible for locomotive's overall system design while the GE unit developed the engine system.
